method: Instruction listings decoded directly from the PE bytes of the identified executable through its section table, with the executable size and SHA-256 verified first. Every cited instruction address, operand, name literal, holder vftable cell, type descriptor name and call target was compared with those listings. Callers were enumerated by scanning the .text section for rel32 call and jmp instructions, so virtual and indirect callers are not covered. Addresses are absolute virtual addresses. No decompiled body is a tracked evidence dependency.
scope: Static Lua call contracts of the nine SpreadSheet natives that the earlier contracts do not record: the cache reads _getData, _isExistKey and _getAllKey, the yielding load requests _loadKeyTemporarily, _loadKeySemipermanently and _loadAllKeyPermanently, the release _unloadKey and the asynchronous requests _loadKeyAsync and _loadMultiKeyAsync. Each row gives the registration site, receiver type check, declared argument and return lists, reads, client state effects, failure behavior and yield behavior. The rows also record the shape of the row cache, the key range vector and the load request machinery as far as the callbacks reach it. Client-side contracts do not establish sheet content, server behavior or the Lua wrapper logic.
evidenceTier: MIXED, see tierVocabulary and the tier of each fact

tierVocabulary.STATIC: Read directly from instructions or data at the cited addresses.
tierVocabulary.INFERRED: A name or role assigned from the surrounding instructions. The bytes do not state it.

framework.reference: manifests/widget_native_call_contract.json framework and manifests/talk_native_call_contract.json framework: registration, the 0x00CC9D60 type registry, argument marshalling through 0x00D19A20, the holder receiver adapter and the return pushers.

registration.switchboard: 0x00758670, slot 2 of the SpreadSheet vftable 0x00FD7744 (RTTI .?AVSpreadSheet@Control@Client@Script@Lua@Application@@). It tests the byte at its argument +0x0E before each step. A nonzero byte adds 1 to the word at +0x0C and skips the registrar, otherwise it calls the registrar with the argument and the receiver in ECX.
registration.note: Each registrar has this one rel32 caller in .text.

framework.listOrder: Every registrar builds the return list first and the argument list second. The wrapper call pushes the return list, the argument list, an adjustment of 0 from the zeroed EDI, the callback and a stack value, then installs the functor through 0x00CCCAD0 under the name built by 0x00447260. The wrapper stores the argument list at functor +0x14 and the return list at +0x24. The wrappers construct the 0x58 byte functor in place at the index held at wrapper +0x10 of the vector at wrapper +0x04 and increment the index. A failed bound test calls 0x009D22B4.
framework.receiverAdapter: Both holders share the invoke routine 0x00746980. It passes the receiver LuaControl to 0x009DA6CC with source type descriptor 0x01270B4C and target type descriptor 0x012C2308, which names .?AVSpreadSheet@Control@Client@Script@Lua@Application@@. A null cast returns false without calling the callback. A successful cast adds the stored adjustment from holder +0x0C and calls the member function pointer at holder +0x08 with ExecuteParameters on the stack, then returns true. A false result takes the 0x00D19B70 failure path recorded in the talk contract framework.

executeParameters.+0x04: Engine handle. 0x00CC7510 loads the engine pointer from the handle and tail-calls 0x00CD7910, which returns engine +0x220.
executeParameters.+0x08: Lua thread object. The yielding natives pass it to 0x00CD2860 and the function end calls 0x00CD2630 and 0x00CD28C0 act on it.
executeParameters.+0x10: Argument container. Its dword at +0x04 points at the cell vector with first pointer at +0x04, end pointer at +0x08 and 16-byte cells whose tag byte is at +0x0C.
executeParameters.+0x1C: Return container, the receiver of the push routines.

framework.managerChain: Every load callback and _setFilename read the dword at the address 0x00CC7510 returns and then the dword at +0x04 of it, and pass that value in ECX to 0x0075F5A0. The routine loads the dword at ECX and then the dword at that value and tail-calls 0x004D74C0, which returns the dword at +0x174F8 of its receiver. That object is the sheet manager. Its virtual slot 1 takes a filename string address and returns a sheet handle object or null. The class of the manager was not identified.

sheetObject.+0x60: Filename Utf8String. _setFilename assigns it, see the widget contract row.
sheetObject.+0xB4: Sheet handle pointer, stored by _setFilename from slot 1 of the manager.
sheetObject.+0xB8: Set of asynchronously requested keys, with the head sentinel pointer at +0xBC.
sheetObject.+0xC4: Row map object. Head sentinel pointer at +0xC8, entry count at +0xCC, notifier object pointer at +0xD0 and a second container pointer at +0xD4 whose dword at +0x08 is a count.
sheetObject.+0xD8: Address passed as request +0x70 by _loadKeyTemporarily. The object at that address was not traced.
sheetObject.tier: STATIC for the offsets, INFERRED for the roles except the filename and handle, which the _setFilename row records.

sheetHandleSlots.slot 1 (+0x04): Polled by the load request. A nonzero result ends the poll with the dword at 0x0130CECC, INFERRED to be the not done result, on the path where the handle was just obtained.
sheetHandleSlots.slot 2 (+0x08): Takes a column id and returns the column type 1 to 10.
sheetHandleSlots.slot 0x38: Returns a pointer to a dword vector of key range pairs, a start key and a key count. _isExistKey, _getAllKey, _loadAllKeyPermanently, 0x006F0D80 and 0x006DFFC0 read it.
sheetHandleSlots.slot 0x40: Takes a column id and returns a byte. The request keeps the ids for which it is nonzero.
sheetHandleSlots.tier: STATIC for the calls, INFERRED for the roles. The class of the handle object was not identified.

rowCache.outerMap: std::map-shaped tree at SpreadSheet +0xC4. Node key dword at +0x0C, nil byte at +0x21, row counter dword at +0x10, cell map object at +0x14.
rowCache.innerMap: Tree at row node +0x14 with its head pointer at +0x18. Node key dword at +0x0C, nil byte at +0x1D, value pointer at +0x14 and tag byte at +0x18. Scalar cells point at their own value storage and a string cell points at a heap Utf8String.

columnTypeToCell.2: row reader 0x0078E2A0, sign-extended byte, int cell
columnTypeToCell.3: row reader 0x0078E2C0, zero-extended byte, int cell
columnTypeToCell.4: row reader 0x0078E2E0, sign-extended word, int cell
columnTypeToCell.5: row reader 0x0078E300, zero-extended word, int cell

rowCache.dispatch: The jump table is at 0x00748778 and is indexed by the type minus 1 with an unsigned bound of 9. The cases begin at 0x0074848D.
rowCache.tier: STATIC for the shapes, tags and type conversions. The column type meanings and the initial row counter are not traced.

argumentReaders.0x005819A0: Reads cell tag 0, the int, and returns a pointer to the value stored through cell +0x08. A mismatched tag reaches 0x00CCA730 with the registry entry for the expected type.
argumentReaders.0x0071C190: Reads cell tag 4, a LuaControl*, and returns a pointer to the control.

returnPushers.0x00748870: bool, built as a tag 2 value through 0x00583E30 and appended through 0x00584EE0
returnPushers.0x007487C0: Utf8String, built through 0x0073DF70 and appended through 0x00584EE0
returnPushers.0x00748920: Nil, built as a tag 6 cell through 0x00583F70
returnPushers.0x00CFA640: IntegerArray push slot, consumes a count cell and that many int cells into one Lua table

framework.invalidParameterRoute: A failed cell vector size test, an empty key vector read or a find that returns the head sentinel calls 0x009D22B4. The target cursor contract records that routine as the invalid-parameter route that ends in TerminateProcess.
framework.scriptBinding: Each row's scriptBinding names the class and script that xivl-client-scripts:lua/napi_index.json lists for the native. The wrapper methods in gamedata/spreadsheet_u were not read.

arguments.note: Row key. The callback uses it as the key of the outer cache map.
Column index. The callback uses it as the key of the inner cache map.

rows.behavior: Reads two ints and looks the first up in the row map at SpreadSheet +0xC4 through 0x0071CAC0, then the second in the cell map that the found row holds at +0x14 through 0x00CA73F0. The cell at the found inner node is pushed by its tag byte. Tag 0 pushes an int, tag 1 a float, tag 2 a bool, tag 3 a Utf8String and tag 4 Nil. A key that is absent from either map reaches the invalid-parameter route. The callback loads nothing, requests no yield and reads only what an earlier load request cached.

facts.claim: Argument 0 is read at cell 0 and argument 1 at cell 1 through 0x005819A0. Each read is preceded by a cell vector size test that calls 0x009D22B4 on failure.

0x0071CAC0 is a map find. It descends from the head node with a signed compare of the node key at +0x0C, stops at nodes whose byte at +0x21 is set, takes the lower bound and returns it only when its key equals the argument, otherwise the head sentinel. The callback calls it on SpreadSheet +0xC4 with the address of argument 0. The inner find 0x00CA73F0 does the same with the nil byte at +0x1D on the map at row node +0x14.
A find result equal to the head sentinel calls 0x009D22B4 before the node is read. The callback has no other absent-key path.

The found inner node holds a value pointer at +0x14 and a tag byte at +0x18. The callback passes the sign-extended tag and the address of a two dword record to 0x007584B0. The record holds the address of a local that holds the return container from ExecuteParameters +0x1C, and the value pointer.

0x007584B0 dispatches on the tag. Tag 0 pushes the int through 0x00584F70. Tag 1 pushes the float through 0x007489D0. Tag 2 pushes the byte as a bool through 0x00748870. Tag 3 pushes a Utf8String through 0x007487C0. Tag 4 pushes Nil through 0x00748920, which builds a tag 6 cell with 0x00583F70. Any other tag appends nothing.

The return list is one Which operator over int, float, bool and Utf8String. 0x00747910 reserves one slot and calls 0x00747860, which builds the alternatives in 0x00747750 from registry entries 0, 1, 2 and 3 and appends the Which through 0x00CCA2D0. A Nil cell is pushed to Lua as nil by the Which push slot, which tests cell tag 6 first.

Argument 0 is a row key and argument 1 a column index of the loaded sheet. The request poll fills the outer map by key and the inner map by a zero-based column counter, see the load request facts. The Lua wrapper in gamedata/spreadsheet_u was not read.
Whether the Lua side always checks _isExistKey or a load request before _getData, and the process behavior of the invalid-parameter route for an absent key.

arguments.note: Row key tested against the key ranges of the sheet.

rows.behavior: Reads one int, calls virtual slot 0x38 of the object stored at SpreadSheet +0xB4 and scans the returned dword vector as consecutive pairs. A pair holds a start key and a count. The key is present when start <= key <= start + count - 1 for any pair, using signed compares. A null or empty vector gives false. The result is pushed as a bool. No yield, no state write.

facts.claim: The argument is read at cell 0 through 0x005819A0 after a cell vector size test.
The callback loads the pointer at SpreadSheet +0xB4, reads its vftable and calls slot +0x38 with no argument. No instruction tests the pointer for null before the vftable read.

The returned object has the begin pointer at +0x04 and the end pointer at +0x08 of a dword vector. A null begin or an empty vector skips the loop and pushes false. Otherwise the loop steps the index by 2 and tests start <= key and key <= start + count - 1.
The result byte is pushed through 0x00748870 with the return container from ExecuteParameters +0x1C.

The vector is the list of key ranges of the sheet and each pair is a first key and a key count, because the range test and the _getAllKey push read the same slot. The class of the object at +0xB4 was not identified.

returns.handlerPush: 0x00584F70 for the count and each element, consumed by the IntegerArray push slot 0x00CFA640

rows.behavior: Calls virtual slot 0x38 of the object at SpreadSheet +0xB4, then pushes the dword count of the returned vector followed by each dword. The declared return is an IntegerArray, whose push slot reads a count cell and that many int cells and builds one Lua table with the elements under integer keys from 1. The Lua result is therefore one table holding the raw vector, which _isExistKey reads as start and count pairs. No yield, no state write.

facts.claim: The callback loads the pointer at SpreadSheet +0xB4 and calls virtual slot +0x38. No instruction tests the pointer for null.

A null begin pointer gives count 0, otherwise the count is the byte span shifted right by 2. The count is pushed first through 0x00584F70 and then each dword of the vector is pushed through the same routine in a loop from the begin pointer to the end pointer.
The return list holds registry entry 12, IntegerArray, built by 0x0072BBF0 from registry offset 0x30. The argument list is empty.

The IntegerArray push slot 0x00CFA640 reads the cell at the running index. A Nil cell (tag 6) at the count position pushes nil and advances the index by 1. A tag 0 cell is the count: the slot calls 0x00CF3280 with it, then for j from 1 to count pushes the number j and the int of the following cell through 0x00CF3300 and stores the pair through 0x00CF3400, and advances the index by count plus 1. Any other count tag, or any element cell that is not tag 0 (a Nil element included), throws the string literal at 0x00F91C08, bad cast, through 0x009D1B9F.

0x00CF3280, 0x00CF3300 and 0x00CF3400 are the table creation, number push and table store of the embedded Lua library, from their use pattern. The vftable at 0x0110E118 is the StackOperator<IntegerArray> table and slot 2 is the return push by position in the sibling tables.

arguments.note: Low key of the range to load.
High key of the range to load. The range is inclusive.

rows.behavior: Reads a low and a high int. Builds a LoadDataFunctionEndCallbackFinder for the sheet and asks the Lua thread for a registered callback matching it through 0x00CD2630. When none exists the callback allocates a LoadDataFunctionEndCallback for the sheet, registers it on the thread through 0x00CD28C0 and uses it. It then takes the sheet manager from 0x0075F5A0, constructs a LoadDataResumeChecker with the range, the callback, the address of SpreadSheet +0xD8 and the flag 1, and requests a yield through 0x00CD2860 with the checker. The thread resumes once the checker poll reports no pending key.

resumeChecker.finish: Slot 2 at 0x00725B20 runs the request +0x70 handling through 0x00CD2BC0 and 0x00CD2BE0 when +0x70 is nonzero.
resumeChecker.destructor: Slot 0 at 0x00725C60 calls the body at 0x00725BA0.

facts.claim: The arguments are read at cell 0 and cell 1 through 0x005819A0 after cell vector size tests that call 0x009D22B4 on failure.

0x00716EC0 builds a finder on the stack with vftable 0x00FD5714 and the sheet at +0x04. 0x00CD2630 searches the callbacks registered on the Lua thread at ExecuteParameters +0x08. The finder match slot 0x00716F70 casts a candidate to LoadDataFunctionEndCallback and compares the candidate dword at +0x04 with the finder dword at +0x04. A nonzero result skips the creation and is used as the callback.

Without a match the callback allocates 0x28 bytes, reads two thread values through 0x00CD2660 and 0x00CD2680, constructs the callback through 0x0071DB70 with the sheet, the address of +0xC4, the address of +0xD8 and the two values, and registers it through 0x00CD28C0. The constructor stores the sheet at +0x04, the row map address at +0x08, the +0xD8 address at +0x0C, the dword read through the 0x00CD2680 value at +0x10 and the word read through the 0x00CD2660 value at +0x14, builds a key set at +0x18 and stores the byte 1 at +0x24.

0x00725A50 constructs the LoadDataResumeChecker in a 0x94 byte allocation. Its nine stack arguments are the filename string address, the sheet manager object, the address of SpreadSheet +0xB4, the address of +0xC4, the low key, the high key, the function end callback, the address of +0xD8 and a flag byte. It passes the filename argument to 0x00447200 on the object at +0x04 and stores the others at +0x58, +0x5C, +0x60, +0x64, +0x68, +0x6C, +0x70 and +0x90.
The request is built with the sheet filename at +0x60, the manager from 0x0075F5A0, the addresses of +0xB4 and +0xC4, argument 0, argument 1, the callback, the address of +0xD8 and the flag 1.
The yield is requested through 0x00CD2860 on the thread with the request wrapped in a by-value holder. The callback returns at once. Resumption is decided by the checker poll.

The poll 0x00747FB0 is slot 1 of the LoadDataResumeChecker vftable 0x00FD6160. It finishes with the dword at 0x01377ECC when the pending key count at request +0x8C is 0 and with the dword at 0x0130CECC otherwise, the same two cells as the message pool checker.

When the handle cell at SpreadSheet +0xB4 is null the poll asks the manager through its slot 1 with the filename and stores the result. A handle that is still null, or a nonzero result of slot 1 of the new handle, finishes the poll with the dword at 0x0130CECC, INFERRED to be the not done result. A handle that is already set skips that test. The poll then builds the column id list once from slot 0x44, the column count, keeping each zero-based id for which slot 0x40 returns true.

When the pending set is empty the poll scans the key ranges from slot 0x38 and inserts every key k with low <= k <= high that lies in a range into the pending set at request +0x84, and into the key set at callback +0x18 when request +0x6C is nonzero.

For each pending key the poll searches the row map at request +0x60. A found row has its counter at +0x10 incremented and the key leaves the pending set. A missing row is read through a reader built by 0x0078E220 from the handle and the key and tested with 0x0078E270. An available row has each listed column typed by sheet slot 2 and converted to a cell, and is inserted into the row map. A row that is not available stays pending.

The temporary load keeps the rows only for the calling Lua function. The callback records the keys it loads, and its slot 1 at 0x007462F0 finds each recorded key in the row map and calls the release routine 0x006F6160, which decrements the row counter. That the engine invokes that slot when the registering Lua function ends follows from the class name and was not traced.

The initial counter of a row inserted by the poll, the effect of request +0x70 on the loaded rows beyond a size computation through 0x006EE9B0, and the meaning of the flag byte at request +0x90, which no vftable slot of the checker reads.

arguments.note: Low key of the range to load.
High key of the range to load. The range is inclusive.

rows.behavior: Reads a low and a high int. Takes the sheet manager from 0x0075F5A0, constructs a LoadDataResumeChecker with the range, a null callback, a null +0xD8 address and the flag 1 and requests a yield through 0x00CD2860 with it. It never builds or registers a function end callback, so the loaded rows are not recorded for release.

facts.claim: The arguments are read at cell 0 and cell 1 through 0x005819A0 after cell vector size tests that call 0x009D22B4 on failure.

The request is constructed with the filename at +0x60, the manager, the addresses of +0xB4 and +0xC4, argument 0, argument 1, then 0, 0 and 1 for the callback, the +0xD8 address and the flag. The poll then skips the key set insert at request +0x6C and the +0x70 handling.
The yield is requested through 0x00CD2860 with the request on the thread at ExecuteParameters +0x08.
The semipermanent name describes rows that no function end callback releases. They stay in the row map until _unloadKey decrements them. No other release path was traced.

rows.behavior: Takes no argument. Calls virtual slot 0x38 of the object at SpreadSheet +0xB4, reads the first dword of the returned vector as the low key and the sum of the last two dwords as the high key, then constructs a LoadDataResumeChecker with that range, a null callback, a null +0xD8 address and the flag 0, and requests a yield through 0x00CD2860. A null, empty or single-dword vector reaches the invalid-parameter route.

facts.claim: The callback calls slot +0x38 on the pointer at SpreadSheet +0xB4 without testing that handle for null. The low key is the first dword of the vector. With n elements the high key is element n-1 plus element n-2, which is the last pair start plus its count and is one past the last key of the last range. A null or empty vector reaches 0x009D22B4 through the tests at 0x006F0C4C..0x006F0C5D, and the unsigned bound check on count minus 2 at 0x006F0C8A rejects a single-dword vector.

The request is constructed with the filename at +0x60, the manager, the addresses of +0xB4 and +0xC4, the low key, the high key and then 0, 0, 0 for the callback, the +0xD8 address and the flag. The flag differs from the other two load natives, which pass 1.
The yield is requested through 0x00CD2860 with the thread at ExecuteParameters +0x08.

All keys of the sheet are requested because the range spans the first and last key range. Whether keys between the ranges are skipped follows from the poll scan, which inserts only keys inside a listed range.

arguments.note: Low key of the range to release.
High key of the range to release. The range is inclusive.

rows.behavior: Reads a low and a high int and finds the function end callback of the sheet on the Lua thread. For each key from low to high inclusive it looks the key up in the row map. A found row is released through 0x006F6160, which decrements its counter and erases the row at 0 or below, and the key is removed from the callback key set when a callback exists. A key that is absent from the row map is skipped. No yield, no return.

facts.claim: The arguments are read at cell 0 and cell 1 through 0x005819A0 after cell vector size tests.
A finder for the sheet is built through 0x00716EC0 and searched on the Lua thread through 0x00CD2630. The result may be null.
The loop runs from argument 0 to argument 1 inclusive. A low key above the high key runs no iteration. Each key is searched in the row map with 0x0071CAC0 and a head sentinel result skips the key.

A found row is passed to 0x006F6160 with the sheet. The routine decrements the counter at row node +0x10, erases the node through 0x00745710 when the counter is 0 or below, and when the row map is then empty and a container at +0x10 of the map owner is empty and a notifier at +0x0C is set calls slot 1 of the notifier with the sheet. A nonzero callback pointer then removes the key from the callback key set at +0x18 through 0x0071E960, which also clears the callback byte at +0x24.
The row counter is incremented by the poll for an already cached row and by the asynchronous load path 0x006F0D80 for a cached row. The initial counter of a newly inserted row was not traced.

rows.behavior: Reads one int and calls 0x0075CF30 on the object at +0xFC of the engine value with the engine handle, the address of the receiver identity at ExecuteParameters +0x0C and the key. The object holds one outstanding asynchronous key. It releases the previous key of the previous sheet through 0x006F63A0 and loads the new key into the receiver through 0x006F0D80. A cached row has its counter incremented. An uncached key inside a key range is added to the asynchronous key set at SpreadSheet +0xB8 and handed to 0x00CC73E0. No yield.

facts.claim: The argument is read at cell 0 after a cell vector size test.

The callback reads the dword at the address 0x00CC7510 returns and then the dword at +0x04 of it. The object is the dword at +0xFC of that value. The call passes the engine handle, the address of ExecuteParameters +0x0C and the key.

0x0075CF30 keeps an identity dword at +0x00, a key dword at +0x04 and a flag byte at +0x08. A set flag resolves the stored identity through 0x00CC7A50, casts it to SpreadSheet and calls 0x006F63A0 with the stored key. The call then stores the new identity, the key and the flag 1, casts the new receiver to SpreadSheet and calls 0x006F0D80 with the handle and the key.

0x006F63A0 removes the key from the set at SpreadSheet +0xB8 and releases one counter of the cached row through 0x006F6160 when the row exists. 0x006F0D80 tests the key against the key ranges, increments the counter of a cached row, inserts an uncached key into the set at +0xB8 and calls 0x00CC73E0 with the sheet. A key outside every range only runs the empty-cache notifier test.
The body of 0x00CC73E0 and the path by which an asynchronously queued key becomes a cached row.

arguments.note: High key. The range is inclusive.
Owner control. Converted to an identity through 0x00CC73B0.

rows.behavior: Reads a low int, a high int and a control, converts the control to an identity and calls 0x0076E620 on the object at +0xFC of the engine value with the engine handle, the receiver identity address, both ints and the control identity. The callee first releases the keys recorded for the same receiver and control pair, then appends a node for the pair and requests every key in the range that lies in a key range through 0x006F0D80. No yield and no return.

facts.claim: The three arguments are read at cells 0, 1 and 2. Cells 0 and 1 use 0x005819A0 and cell 2 uses 0x0071C190, which tests cell tag 4 and returns the control. The argument list is built by 0x00747500 from registry entries 0, 0 and 4.

The control is converted to an identity through 0x00CC73B0 and passed with the engine handle, the receiver identity address, the low and high keys to 0x0076E620 on the object at +0xFC of the engine value.

0x0076E620 casts the receiver to SpreadSheet and walks the list at its own +0x0C for a node whose dword at +0x08 equals the receiver identity and whose dword at +0x0C equals the control identity and whose byte at +0x2C is 0. A matching node has each key of its vector at +0x1C..+0x20 released through 0x006F63A0 and is erased through 0x00783CD0.

A new node is built through 0x00784FB0 for the receiver, control and range. For each key from low to high inclusive, 0x006DFFC0 tests the key against the key ranges of the sheet and, when it passes, 0x006F0D80 requests it and the key is appended to the node vector. The node is then appended to the list.
The remaining node fields, the consumer of the byte at node +0x2C and the Lua script that supplies the control.

relatedNatives.note: Assigns SpreadSheet +0x60 and stores the manager slot 1 result at +0xB4. The ledger row is shared with CutScene and WidgetBase.

ledgerCandidates.note: These are the SpreadSheet rows of the unimplemented ledger that this record gives a registration, argument list, return list, receiver check and callback contract. _loadKeyAsync has no ledger row and no corpus call site. A client that implements the rows still needs the sheet manager, the key range vector, the column types and the cell values from decoded static client data, which this record does not supply.

nextTranche.note: The ranked list of the next natives lives in the nameplate, actor and group contract.

boundaries: These are static client observations. No live Lua call or retail-client walk was performed.
Each registrar has one rel32 caller in .text, recorded as registrarCaller. The run-time order of registration is the switchboard order in the framework.
Script call-site lines are static presence in the shipped scripts. They do not establish which natives a given script reaches at run time.
The classes of the sheet manager and the sheet handle objects were not identified, so slot roles are INFERRED from use.
The poll was followed through the key scan, the row cache insert and the finish cells. The row reader bodies, the notifier and the asynchronous queue behind 0x00CC73E0 were not traced.
The invalid-parameter route ends in a process terminate on the evidence of the target cursor contract. Whether the handler cell at 0x01363F1C holds a handler at run time is unknown.
These are client marshalling and state contracts. They do not establish sheet content, the Lua wrapper logic or server behavior.
